display_fil: Kaso: Umuubo si Ben at hirap huminga
display_en: Case: Ben is coughing and has difficulty breathing
narration_fil: Umuubo si Ben at hirap huminga. May nag-alok ng Lagundi na pinagpakuluan.
narration_en: Ben is coughing and has difficulty breathing. Someone offers a Lagundi decoction.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Vitex negundo. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay dahon; ang paksang gamit ay pagpapagaan ng ubo sa payo ng clinician. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Iugnay agad si Ben sa health professional at iulat ang hirap sa paghinga.
narration_en: Find Vitex negundo on the reference card. The listed part is leaves; the use topic is cough relief under clinical advice. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Connect Ben promptly to a health professional and report the breathing difficulty.

Ano ang unang tugon?

display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Lagundi ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Lagundi part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Lagundi.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Lagundi is unconfirmed.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

narration_fil: Itinuro ng BHW ang Lagundi at botanical name sa card. Hindi niya pinaghulaang tama ang halamang nasa bakuran. Iugnay agad si Ben sa health professional at iulat ang hirap sa paghinga.
narration_en: The BHW points to Lagundi and its botanical name on the card. The yard plant is not assumed to be identified. Connect Ben promptly to a health professional and report the breathing difficulty.

narration_fil: Huwag hayaang maantala ng herbal na inumin ang pagsusuri sa hirap sa paghinga. Huwag magtakda ng dose ayon sa lumang slide. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: An herbal drink must not delay assessment of breathing difficulty. Do not copy the old slide’s dose. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na sagot sa kaso ni Lagundi?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in the Lagundi case?

options.fil: Gayahin ang lumang timpla nang walang pagsusuri.
options.en: Copy an old recipe without assessment.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala o mapalitan ang kinakailangang pangangalaga. 2: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo. 3: Hindi kapalit ng kasalukuyang clinical guidance ang lumang timpla.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang card na may pangalang Lagundi. Markahan ang botanical name, dahon, nakalistang gamit at referral. Ipasuri ang card sa supervisor.
narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Lagundi. Mark the botanical name, leaves, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
